entities.name: RimP
observations: The 219-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein A8M743 from Salinispora arenicola.
RimP is required for maturation and assembly of the bacterial 30S ribosomal subunit.
The query contains Pfam RimP_N (PF02576.23), residues 46–121.

entities.name: RimP sequence properties
observations: Length 219 aa; estimated molecular mass 23.64 kDa; theoretical pI 4.93; predicted charge at pH 7 is −11.1; GRAVY −0.678; instability index 30.38.
These are unmodified sequence-derived estimates and do not account for processing, post-translational modifications, ligands, or oligomerization.

entities.name: 30S ribosomal subunit assembly
observations: RimP is annotated with GO:0000028, ribosomal small subunit assembly, and GO:0006412, translation.
